resources.string: Enter the whole PIN again, the way you will every time: the digits, then the operators. Do not press or hold =. It saves when the last operator is entered. Press CLR to restart the repeat.
Enter the same whole digits first (0–9 only), then the operators. Do not press =.
Enter the same digits as your first entry (at least 3), then the operators. Do not press =.
After the digits, enter only the operators of your sequence (+ − × ÷ ^). Do not press =.
